name: Brixia

attributes.attribute: the consort of the water-god Luxovius
linked by some scholars to the Irish Brigit

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brixia is an obscure Continental Celtic goddess. She is the consort of Luxovius, the water-god of Luxeuil. Her other name is Bricta. Scholars often suggest a link between Brixia and the Irish Brigit, but they have yet to prove it. She belongs to the healing and water cult of the warm springs of Luxeuil in eastern France.
